parameters.jsCode:
const d = $('Prep Outreach Context').item.json;
const companyName = d.company_homepage_name || d.company_name_clean || d.company_name || '';
const websiteUrl = d.url_validated || d.best_url || '';
const prompt = [
  'Company: ' + companyName,
  'Website URL: ' + websiteUrl,
  'Role: ' + (d.role || 'N/A'),
  'Message track: ' + (d.message_track || 'UNKNOWN'),
  'Regulatory track: ' + (d.regulatory_track || 'UNKNOWN'),
  'Service type: ' + (d.service_type || 'unknown'),
  'Company size: ' + (d.company_size || 'Unknown'),
  'Offer track: ' + (d.offer_track || 'VERIFY'),
  'Implementation window: ' + (d.implementation_window || 'UNKNOWN'),
  'Sector track: ' + (d.sector_track || 'unknown'),
  'Personal data risk: ' + (d.personal_data_risk || 'unknown'),
  'NEHR relevant: ' + (d.nehr_relevant || 'UNKNOWN'),
  'Funding track primary: ' + (d.funding_track_primary || 'VERIFY'),
  'Funding track secondary: ' + (d.funding_track_secondary || 'NONE'),
  'Funding confidence: ' + (d.funding_confidence || 'LOW'),
  'Classification evidence: ' + (d.classification_evidence || 'N/A'),
  'Classification source URL: ' + (d.classification_source_url || websiteUrl || 'N/A'),
  '',
  'Determine:',
  '1. vendor_pain: The specific compliance or data-protection pain this company faces. Max 15 words.',
  '2. grant_eligibility: Must be exactly one of: NCG | NCG + PSG | NCG + CSA CISOaaS | NCG + CSA CISOaaS + PSG | CSA CISOaaS | CSA CISOaaS + PSG | NCSS TSS | Verify eligibility | None',
  '3. compliance_trigger: A short phrase, max 12 words, describing why this company should care now.',
  '4. evidence_gap: A short phrase, max 8 words, describing the likely operational weakness.',
  '5. executive_angle: A short phrase, max 10 words, describing the leadership lens.',
  '6. cta_style: choose a natural CTA based on the contact role.',
  '',
  'Track rules:',
  '- HIA_PROVIDER: focus HIA / CSDS / audit evidence / ownership / renewal timing.',
  '- HIA_VENDOR: focus customer due diligence, healthcare buyer confidence, and readiness proof.',
  '- NCSS: focus beneficiary/client data protection, limited internal bandwidth, and fundable cyber/data-governance work.',
  '- PDPA_OTHER: focus personal-data governance, internal ownership, evidence gathering, and client/customer trust.',
  '- If funding_track_primary = NCSS_TSS, grant_eligibility must be NCSS TSS.',
  '- If funding_track_primary = NONE, grant_eligibility must be None.',
  '- If funding_track_primary = VERIFY, grant_eligibility must be Verify eligibility.',
  '- If funding_track_primary = NCG and funding_track_secondary = NONE, use NCG.',
  '- If funding_track_primary = NCG and funding_track_secondary = CSA_CISOAAS_HIA and company_size = SME, prefer NCG + CSA CISOaaS + PSG.',
  '- If funding_track_primary = NCG and funding_track_secondary = CSA_CISOAAS_HIA and company_size is not SME, use NCG + CSA CISOaaS.',
  '- If funding_track_primary = CSA_CISOAAS and funding_track_secondary = PSG, use CSA CISOaaS + PSG.',
  '- If funding_track_primary = CSA_CISOAAS and funding_track_secondary = NONE, use CSA CISOaaS.',
  '- If funding_confidence is LOW and funding_track_primary is not NCG, NCSS_TSS, or CSA_CISOAAS, prefer Verify eligibility.',
  '',
  'Output JSON: {"vendor_pain":"","grant_eligibility":"","compliance_trigger":"","evidence_gap":"","executive_angle":"","cta_style":""}',
  'Output: valid JSON only. No markdown.'
].join('\n');
const body = {
  model: 'minimax/minimax-m2.7',
  temperature: 0.1,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }]
};
return { json: { requestBody: body, _ctx: d } };

const d = $json._ctx;
const pain = $json;
const firstName = d.first_name || 'there';
const companyName = d.company_homepage_name || d.company_name_clean || d.company_name || '';
const websiteUrl = d.url_validated || d.best_url || '';
const rawContent = d.website_content || '';
const cleanLines = rawContent.split('\n').filter((line) => {
  const l = line.trim();
  return l.length > 40 && !l.startsWith('![') && !l.startsWith('* [') && !l.startsWith('*   [') && !l.startsWith('- [') && !l.includes('](http') && !l.startsWith('#');
}).join(' ');
const websiteSummary = cleanLines.substring(0, 600) || (d.serper_results || '').substring(0, 600);
const techRoles = ['cto','ciso','it director','technical','engineer','developer','architect','infosec','head of it','vp engineering','chief information'];
const isTechnical = techRoles.some((t) => (d.role || '').toLowerCase().includes(t));
const email1cta = isTechnical ? 'Want me to send it across?' : 'Could you forward this to your IT, security, or compliance team?';
const messageTrack = String(d.message_track || '').trim();
const email2Subject = messageTrack === 'NCSS' ? 'Funding support for ' + companyName + "'s data protection readiness" : messageTrack === 'PDPA_OTHER' ? 'Up to 70% co-funded for ' + companyName + "'s CEM readiness" : 'Up to 70% co-funded for ' + companyName + "'s compliance readiness";
const prompt = [
  'You are a cold email expert. Write 4 personalized outreach emails on behalf of Sasikumar, Account Executive at RAYN Secure. RAYN Secure helps Singapore organisations improve cybersecurity, data protection, and compliance readiness, including HIA/CSDS, NCSS-funded data protection work, CSA CISOaaS support for Cyber Essentials / CEM readiness, and broader personal-data governance.',
  '',
  '--- DETAILS',
  '- First name: ' + firstName,
  '- Company: ' + companyName,
  '- Website URL: ' + websiteUrl,
  '- Message track: ' + (d.message_track || 'N/A'),
  '- Regulatory track: ' + (d.regulatory_track || 'N/A'),
  '- Service type: ' + (d.service_type || 'N/A'),
  '- Offer track: ' + (d.offer_track || 'N/A'),
  '- Implementation window: ' + (d.implementation_window || 'N/A'),
  '- Role: ' + (d.role || 'N/A'),
  '- Pain point: ' + (pain.vendor_pain || 'N/A'),
  '- Personal data risk: ' + (d.personal_data_risk || 'N/A'),
  '- Funding track primary: ' + (d.funding_track_primary || 'N/A'),
  '- Funding track secondary: ' + (d.funding_track_secondary || 'N/A'),
  '- Grant eligibility: ' + (pain.grant_eligibility || 'N/A'),
  '- Classification evidence: ' + (d.classification_evidence || 'N/A'),
  '- Website summary: ' + websiteSummary,
  '',
  '# EMAIL SPECIFICATIONS',
  '## Email 1 - URGENCY HOOK',
  '- Subject should reflect the current timing, ownership, or funding pressure for this message track',
  '- 75-100 words',
  '- Open with urgency/opportunity -> empathy -> proof or funding relief -> low-ask CTA',
  '',
  '## Email 2 - ROLE-SPECIFIC PAIN',
  '- 60-90 words',
  '- Role-aware pain -> pressure -> proof/funding -> CTA',
  '',
  '## Email 3 - SOCIAL PROOF OR SECTOR OBSERVATION',
  '- 70-100 words',
  '- Use named proof when it fits the track; otherwise use a credible sector observation -> proof -> CTA',
  '',
  '## Email 4 - LOW-FRICTION',
  '- 40-60 words',
  '- Direct, yes/no ask',
  '',
  '# TRACK-AWARE',
  '- HIA_PROVIDER: HIA / CSDS controls, audit evidence, renewal timing, internal ownership',
  '- HIA_VENDOR: healthcare buyer scrutiny, vendor readiness, sales-cycle proof',
  '- NCSS: beneficiary/client data protection, limited bandwidth, funding support',
  '- PDPA_OTHER: personal-data governance, ownership, evidence gathering, customer/client trust',
  '',
  'Named proof examples by sector:',
  '- Eldercare/social service: Sree Narayana Mission, Society for the Aged Sick, Caring Fleet, CFS Centre for Seniors',
  '- Clinic/hospital/AI vendor: Ren Ci Hospital, Tsao Foundation',
  '- For PDPA_OTHER, do not force healthcare proof if it does not fit; use a sector-specific observation instead',
  '',
  '--- RULES',
  '1. 60-80 words per email body - count carefully',
  '2. Match the exact paragraph structure of the examples',
  '3. Use arrows -> for lists (Email 2 and Email 4)',
  '4. Email 1 CTA: ' + email1cta,
  '5. Email 2 subject locked to: ' + email2Subject,
  '6. Email 4 subject locked to: Should I close the loop, ' + firstName + '?',
  '7. Do NOT use sycophantic openers',
  '8. Do NOT add adjectives: rapidly, seamlessly, comprehensive, robust',
  '9. Sign off every email: Best, - no variation, no titles',
  '',
  'Output format: JSON with exactly 8 keys - subject_line1, email_body1, subject_line2, email_body2, subject_line3, email_body3, subject_line4, email_body4',
  'Output: valid JSON only. No markdown.'
].join('\n');
const body = {
  model: 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6',
  temperature: 0.4,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }]
};
return { json: { requestBody: body, _ctx: d, _pain: pain } };

const d = $json;
return { json: {
  Id: $('Loop Over Items').item.json.Id,
  status:            d.status,
  vendor_pain:       d.vendor_pain,
  grant_eligibility: d.grant_eligibility,
  compliance_trigger: d.compliance_trigger,
  evidence_gap:      d.evidence_gap,
  executive_angle:   d.executive_angle,
  cta_style:         d.cta_style,
  subject_line_1: d.subject_line_1,
  email_body_1:   d.email_body_1,
  subject_line_2: d.subject_line_2,
  email_body_2:   d.email_body_2,
  subject_line_3: d.subject_line_3,
  email_body_3:   d.email_body_3,
  subject_line_4: d.subject_line_4,
  email_body_4:   d.email_body_4
} };
